title: 从电表读数到可解释的账单与结算
scope: Synthetic retail electricity interval example in UTC. Four 15-minute kWh intervals, two TOU prices, fixed fee; no taxes, demand charges, import/export offsets or wholesale market settlement. Estimated usage permission and correction policy are explicit teaching assumptions.

transitions.guard: 设备、服务点、倍率、通道与有效起点获确认
transitions.durable_effect: 保存安装版本与起点
transitions.recovery: 映射缺失数据隔离

transitions.guard: 有效终点明确且不与替代关系含混重叠
transitions.durable_effect: 保存旧关系终点和新关系引用
transitions.recovery: 重算受影响历史期间时仍使用旧关系

transitions.guard: 单位、源身份、区间和有效安装关系明确
transitions.durable_effect: 保存映射与原始值
transitions.recovery: 重复源身份返回原记录

transitions.guard: 缺单位/时间歧义/映射冲突之一
transitions.durable_effect: 保存失败原因与源 payload
transitions.recovery: 补充权威映射后重新处理

transitions.guard: 保留原错误且新依据明确
transitions.durable_effect: 保存处理版本
transitions.recovery: 不得把缺失默认为零

transitions.guard: 规则顺序与资格冻结
transitions.durable_effect: 保存异常、Pre/Post 与质量码
transitions.recovery: 修改后重新运行且不删除旧异常

transitions.guard: 单缺口估算满足本例条件/实测校验通过
transitions.durable_effect: 保存规则与测量版本
transitions.recovery: 输入改变必须重算

transitions.guard: 有覆盖权限、依据和理由
transitions.durable_effect: 追加修订并关闭对应异常
transitions.recovery: 不能直接编辑已发布金额

transitions.guard: 质量政策允许用于当前用途
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 final 版本并发出修订通知
transitions.recovery: 下游失败保留可重放事件

transitions.trigger: 新实际值或合法更正生效
transitions.guard: 新修订 finalized
transitions.durable_effect: 保留新旧关联并标记受影响数量
transitions.recovery: 乱序旧事件不可恢复旧版

transitions.guard: 期间、单位、测量版本与规则完备
transitions.durable_effect: 保存谷/峰数量与估算电量比例
transitions.recovery: 缺输入保持 requested/异常待办

transitions.guard: 估算电量比例 <=30% 且无未决阻断
transitions.durable_effect: 保存批准证据与输入 hash
transitions.recovery: 上限改25%须拒绝本例4/14

transitions.guard: 版本尚有效且 operation 持久化
transitions.durable_effect: 保存发布引用
transitions.recovery: 响应未知核对原 operation

transitions.guard: 新数量版本已算出且关联完整
transitions.durable_effect: 保存新旧差异与调整待办
transitions.recovery: 原账单仍引用原数量

transitions.guard: 计费数量已批准、费率有效且唯一 operation
transitions.durable_effect: 保存外部 ID 和金额13.50
transitions.recovery: timeout 先查询原发布

transitions.guard: 原账单金额保留，合法差额规则批准
transitions.durable_effect: 追加2.00调整及依据
transitions.recovery: 重复新旧数量版本只产生一次调整

transitions.guard: 银行交易与账户/账单映射核对且未重复分配
transitions.durable_effect: 保存allocation10.00及余额3.50
transitions.recovery: 未知先核对银行及既有分配

transitions.guard: 可分配资金与剩余应收一致
transitions.durable_effect: 余额为0，保存第二笔交易引用
transitions.recovery: 重放不重复资金

transitions.trigger: 已结清后出现争议调整2.00
transitions.guard: 保留旧账单与原核销且争议获登记
transitions.durable_effect: 保存新争议余额2.00
transitions.recovery: 不可无痕改旧账单或自动扣款

transitions.guard: 授权人明确结果和调整依据
transitions.durable_effect: 记录释放剩余应收
transitions.recovery: 若减免则另存贷项与批准，不伪造付款

checks.given: 15-minute UTC interval kWh=[2,3,null,5]; prices=[0.50,0.50,1.00,1.00]; fixed=2.00; estimate limit30%
checks.when: Estimate isolated hole, approve, issue and match payments10.00 then3.50
checks.then: Post=[2,3,4,5]; valley5 peak9; estimate share4/14; bill13.50; balance3.50 then0
checks.evidence_required: Frozen input, pre/post values and flags, determinant versions, issued bill and two bank allocation IDs

checks.given: A raw batch and bank transaction T-1 already committed
checks.then: No duplicate interval energy or payment allocation
checks.evidence_required: Source and bank unique-key logs; quantities and allocation totals

checks.given: Actual revision6 finalized before old estimated revision4 notification
checks.then: Current effective value stays6; estimate4 remains historical; revised bill basis15.50
checks.evidence_required: Revision ordering, input snapshot hash and adjustment linkage

checks.given: Two analysts edit same base revision; issue request races with revised input
checks.then: One stale edit rejected; published bill has fixed snapshot; subsequent change uses adjustment
checks.evidence_required: Conflict response, transaction versions, immutable published basis

checks.given: Tenants A/B share local meter ID,SP-1 and bill number
checks.when: Query raw curve, preview cache, export and payment lookup
checks.then: No cross-tenant data for hit, miss or rebuild
checks.evidence_required: Tenant-collision fixture and access audit for each path

checks.given: External ledger creates B-1 but response is lost
checks.when: Reconcile by same persisted operation reference
checks.then: One bill B-1; UI changes unknown to issued after confirmation
checks.evidence_required: Fault at response boundary, external listing and local mapping

checks.given: Actual value6 yields2.00 adjustment already stored, consumer marker absent
checks.then: Exactly one2.00 adjustment; original13.50 allocation preserved; disputed balance2.00
checks.evidence_required: Adjustment unique key old/new determinant; crash log; ledger reconciliation

checks.when: Apply single-gap rule or approve4/14 estimated energy
checks.then: Both fail explicitly; no zero filling and no confusion with25% interval count
checks.evidence_required: Negative fixture result with exact failed guard and remaining exception

checks.given: 00:30 exchange; old multiplier1 new2; raw=[2,3,2,2.5] all measured
checks.then: Post=[2,3,4,5],bill13.50,estimated energy0; wrong multiplier gives9.00 and must be detected
checks.evidence_required: Installation-boundary trace, quantity/quality assertions, wrong-policy negative comparison
